q: What age group is Temple Girl Kids designed for?
a: Temple Girl Kids is designed for children aged 3 to 10. Each story is narrated in simple, warm, and engaging language, making it enjoyable for younger children listening with a parent as well as older children listening independently.

q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
a: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time through the Manage Subscription page. There are no long-term commitments or cancellation fees.

q: Can my child use Temple Girl Kids on multiple devices?
a: Yes. You can sign in with the same account on both Android and iOS devices. Please note that your account can only be actively signed in on one device at a time.

q: Is there a free way to try the stories?
a: Yes. Every story includes a one-minute free preview in the app. You can also listen to a complete story for free directly on our website before subscribing.

q: How often are new stories added?
a: We release two new stories every week, giving your child something new to discover regularly. New stories are released every Tuesday and Saturday at 8 PM IST.

q: Is Temple Girl Kids safe for children?
a: Absolutely. Temple Girl Kids is designed with children in mind, with no advertisements, inappropriate content, or child tracking. The service is designed to comply with applicable children's privacy and data-protection requirements, including COPPA and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
